{{Quote|Can anyone give me a ''boost''? I can barely see over this table!|Emf Diddar, to the other delegates at the conference on Gus Talon|<ref name="Power Down">{{TCWComicCite|6.45|Power Down}}</ref>}}
[[Senior Foreman]] '''Emf Diddar''' was an [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] negotiator and union representative who lived during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Following an increase in [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] activity around the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Gus Talon/Legends|Gus Talon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Diddar attended a [[Conference on Gus Talon|conference]] that was held on the world to discuss how to address the problem. The meeting took place within an automated [[Gus Talon diplomatic complex|facility]] and the event was hijacked by a rogue Separatist [[GNK power droid/Legends|GNK power droid]], which took over the structure's controls. Amid the chaos Diddar was ensnared by two mechanical [[Limb/Legends|arms]] that were affixed to the walls of the building. However, he was freed after the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] disabled the [[Power droid/Legends|power droid]].
